study type: secondary analysis of a cohort study
exposure: high-risk cfDNA screening results for 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (22q11.2DS)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 18,020 pregnant participants enrolled in the SMART study between 2015 and 2019, who underwent cfDNA screening for 22q11.2 deletion syndrome.
finding: High-risk cfDNA screening results for 22q11.2DS were associated with higher rates of prenatal diagnostic testing, fetal echocardiography, and various 22q11.2DS-specific neonatal evaluations, though these interventions were not universally performed.
